title: MYTH BUSTED — Fallout 3 Numbers Station

subject.legend: Predictive Numbers Station / prophetic Galaxy News Radio broadcast

purpose: Preserve a machine-readable forensic summary of the Fallout 3 Numbers Station legend, separating real shipped radio/Morse mechanics from later prophetic claims and explicitly recording the evidence ceiling.

myth_claim.summary: Variants of the legend claim that after killing Three Dog and satisfying additional radio or Raven Rock conditions, Galaxy News Radio can begin broadcasting number sequences, Morse code, dates, or messages that predict real-world events.
variant_conditions_reported_online: Galaxy News Radio is not repaired or is otherwise disrupted
some retellings add an impossible or unsupported Margaret-death condition

confirmed_game_mechanics.claim: Three Dog is a real killable NPC and his death changes Galaxy News Radio state.
confirmed_game_mechanics.evidence: Community-extracted game-script records identify ThreeDogScript and a ThreeDogDead flag used by the GNR radio quest.

confirmed_game_mechanics.claim: After Three Dog dies, Margaret can be heard as a replacement radio voice.
confirmed_game_mechanics.evidence: Extracted dialogue/voice inventories contain Margaret replacement lines associated with Galaxy News Radio.

confirmed_game_mechanics.claim: Margaret is not encountered as a normal placed NPC that the player can kill in vanilla gameplay.
confirmed_game_mechanics.evidence: The replacement behavior is represented through radio dialogue/voice assets rather than a documented placed killable Margaret reference. This matches direct player observation recorded in the originating discussion.

confirmed_game_mechanics.claim: Fallout 3 contains genuine Morse-code radio signals unrelated to the prophetic Numbers Station legend.
confirmed_game_mechanics.example_payload: CQ CQ CQ DE OT K

confirmed_game_mechanics.claim: Raven Rock destruction affects real radio/news state, but no verified branch has been found that converts GNR into a prophetic Numbers Station.

negative_findings.target: Three Dog voice assets reading prophetic number sequences
Morse payload encoding the claimed real-world predictions
explicit game record for 01:27 on 6 July 2027
normal gameplay trigger requiring Margaret to be killed

legend_message_forensics.finding: The preserved creepypasta tradition does not securely bind a unique message text to 01:27 on 6 July 2027. Later retellings commonly attach the catastrophic 'science went too far / universe unraveling' message to that date, but the linkage is not stable across versions.
legend_message_forensics.historical_note: Earlier mirrored variants assign different dates to catastrophic text, indicating mutation of the legend rather than a stable recovered game transmission. Mirror timestamps themselves require caution because migrated forum metadata may be unreliable.

why_the_myth_was_plausible: Fallout 3 genuinely contains hidden or weak radio signals.
Several of those signals genuinely use Morse code.
Galaxy News Radio genuinely changes behavior after his death.
Margaret genuinely replaces Three Dog as a radio voice without existing as a normal player-facing NPC.
Raven Rock genuinely participates in radio/news state changes.
The false legend combines these real mechanics into one unsupported final transition.

source_register.source: GamesRadar investigation of the Fallout 3 Numbers Station story
Community-extracted Fallout 3 GNR scripts/dialogue and long-standing modding records
Originating JANUS dialogue and player observation

claim_ceiling.statement: This record debunks the legend as an established documented vanilla Fallout 3 mechanic on the evidence reviewed. It does not prove the logical impossibility of hidden content in every historical, regional, development, or modified build.

strongest_next_gate.goal: Convert the current evidence-backed debunk into an exact shipped-build forensic proof.
required_inputs: exact file hashes and game version/build identity
procedure: build dependency closure from ThreeDog, RadioGalaxyNewsQuest, ThreeDogDead, RadioGNRScript and MQ09.RRDestroy
enumerate all reachable radio state transitions
search for numeric/date/2027 candidate assets and orphan records
publish machine-readable positive/negative inventory with hashes
